Java guide for com.azure:azure-security-keyvault-keys: KeyClient/CryptographyClient creation with DefaultAzureCredential, RSA/EC/OCT key creation, listing, update, delete/recover/purge, rotation policies, import, backup/restore, and encrypt/decrypt/sign/verify/wrap samples.

No commands for the agent to run, no package-manager invocations (only a Maven <dependency> snippet), and no instruction to read or expose real secrets. Key create/delete/purge and backup-to-file calls are sample code that runs only if the user executes it against their own vault.
Users should note that the sample purgeDeletedKey (SKILL.md:196, references/examples.md:314) is irreversible and the backup sample (SKILL.md:270) writes key backup material to a local file.
